تعتبرن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَبِرْنَ (taʕtabirna) /taʕ.ta.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# تُعْتَبَرْنَ (tuʕtabarna) /tuʕ.ta.bar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
